headline: WHITE GOLD: 3.23 g/t OVER 56m AT GOLDEN SADDLE — Arc Extends 100m Down Plunge; PEA Now Underway With 3 Rigs Turning (TSXV: WGO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / White Gold Corp.
snippet: White Gold Corp. (TSXV: WGO) updated its fully funded 2026 exploration program on July 29, reporting 18 holes and 7,000 metres drilled across the district-scale White Gold and QV Properties in Yukon — including highlight intersections of 3.23 g/t Au over 56.1 metres and 6.89 g/t Au over 50.2 metres at Golden Saddle, and the first down-plunge extension of the Arc deposit by at least 100 metres. Three rigs are actively turning, targeting resource growth at Golden Saddle, Arc, Ryan's Surprise, and VG, as well as early signals at new Golden Saddle 2.0 and VG East zones. A Maiden Preliminary Economic Assessment is underway on the White Gold Project, with assays and the PEA expected in the near term.

headline: ORLA-EQUINOX MERGER CLOSES FRIDAY — BC Court Signs Off; $18.5B Deal Creates Canada's New #2 Gold Producer at 1.1M oz/yr
snippet: The Supreme Court of British Columbia granted the final order approving the Orla Mining and Equinox Gold business combination on July 28, clearing the last hurdle before the deal closes on or about July 31, 2026. The $18.5 billion all-share transaction — approved by 99.91% of Orla shareholders and 99.83% of Equinox shareholders — will create Canada's second-largest gold producer behind Agnico Eagle, with combined annual production of approximately 1.1 million ounces and a clear path to 1.9 million ounces through expansion projects already under construction. Orla shareholders receive one Equinox Gold share plus US$0.0001 cash per share; both TSX and NYSE American listings are approved and ready.

headline: DENISON PHOENIX ISR ENTERS FULL CONSTRUCTION — Canada's First Commercial ISR Uranium Mine, $700M Build, 9M lb U3O8/yr Peak, Target 2028
snippet: Denison Mines Corp. (TSX: DML) announced July 28 that site preparation activities at the Phoenix in-situ recovery uranium mine are complete and full-scale construction has commenced, including installation of the first perimeter freeze wall — the core engineering innovation that allows uranium-bearing solution to be recovered without conventional open-pit or underground mining. Phoenix is the first large-scale uranium mine approved in Canada in more than 20 years and will be the country's first commercial ISR operation, targeting peak production of approximately 9 million pounds U₃O₈ annually at the Athabasca Basin project. The US$500 million ($700M CAD) project posts an after-tax NPV(8%) of US$1.57 billion and 73% IRR; first uranium production is targeted for mid-2028. Denison owns 90% of Wheeler River directly and a further 5% through JCU.

headline: WESTHAVEN DRILLS 200 g/t AU RECORD ASSAY + 27.51m @ 14.47 g/t — Dundee Deploys 5th Drill for Discovery Phase (TSXV: WHN)
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSXV: WHN) released July 28 the fourth batch of assays from its ongoing 35,000-metre South Zone infill program at the Shovelnose Gold Property in southern British Columbia, with hole SNR26-99 delivering a headline interval of 27.51 metres grading 14.47 g/t Au and 52.3 g/t Ag, alongside a 0.52-metre section grading 200 g/t Au and 141 g/t Ag — the highest single assay from the entire infill program to date. Additional holes returned 30.76 metres at 3.31 g/t Au and 16.80 metres at 4.63 g/t Au, confirming broad South Zone continuity. Under Dundee Corporation's CDN$85 million earn-in agreement, a fifth diamond drill is now active on a companion 15,000-metre exploration program testing greenfield targets on the Spences Bridge Gold Belt through mid-December 2026.

headline: FIREFLY METALS: 42m @ 6.1% CuEq + 9.8m VMS CORE AT 16.5% — Green Bay PEA August; A$196M Funded (ASX/TSX: FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals Ltd. (ASX/TSX: FFM) published July 27 further underground drilling results from the Green Bay Copper-Gold Project in Newfoundland and Labrador, including 42.0 metres grading 6.1% copper equivalent containing a 9.8-metre Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide interval at 16.5% CuEq, and a companion hole returning 51.5 metres at 4.9% CuEq. The Core Zone — now measuring 8.8 million tonnes at 3.9% CuEq in M&I categories — will underpin early, high-margin production at a potential restart of the historic Ming Mine. Following these results, FireFly elected to incorporate an updated Mineral Resource Estimate into its PEA/Scoping Study before release, moving the completion date to August 2026. The company is funded with approximately A$196.4 million in cash and liquid investments; maiden drilling has also commenced at the Tilt Cove project.

headline: U.S. DFC BACKS HARENA'S MADAGASCAR RARE EARTHS WITH $4.84M — First Direct American Bet Against China's REE Supply Lock
snippet: Harena Rare Earths plc signed a Project Development Funding Agreement with the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation on July 22, securing up to US$4.84 million for permitting, environmental and social studies, and a proof-of-concept pilot plant at the Ampasindava Project in Madagascar. The DFC commitment is the first direct financial contribution from the US government to Ampasindava and signals Washington's intent to compete on African critical minerals soil that China has historically dominated. Harena targets first production from the light rare earth deposit by mid-2028 and is evaluating processing options in the US and Europe; the DFC indicated interest in playing a larger financing role as the project moves toward a construction decision.

headline: DRYDEN GOLD FINDS ELORA 2 AND PAYMASTER — Two New Structures Widen Gold Rock from 500m to 750m (TSXV: DRY)
snippet: Dryden Gold Corp. (TSXV: DRY) announced July 29 the discovery of two new gold-bearing structures at the Gold Rock target in northwestern Ontario, expanding the property's mineralized footprint from 500 metres to 750 metres across strike. The Elora 2 structure was intercepted between the Elora and Big Master gold systems at 250–500 metres true depth, displaying brecciated quartz veining comparable to the high-grade Big Master corridor; the Paymaster target — the first test of a historic working east of Big Master — returned 7.0 metres at 0.36 g/t gold at 120 metres depth in what appears to be a wider shear structure. Elora 2 has no surface expression, and assays for both targets are pending within the company's ongoing 45,000-metre drill program.

headline: LITHIUM DROPS TO 5-MONTH LOW — Three Major Mine Restarts Flood Supply; China Kills Battery Maker Tax Break
snippet: Lithium carbonate prices fell below CNY 145,000 per tonne in late July 2026 — the lowest level in five months — as simultaneous restarts at Mineral Resources' Bald Hill, Core Lithium's Finniss project, and CATL's massive Jianxiawo mine compound a supply overhang that has steadily eroded the rally from May 2025's US$8/kg lows to more than US$25/kg in Q1 2026. China's decision to end tax exemptions for lithium-ion battery manufacturers aims to curb a race-to-the-bottom margin war among producers but creates additional near-term uncertainty for upstream pricing. Grid-scale battery deployment and AI data center power demand continue to provide structural support; the market's direction from here hinges on how quickly the restarted supply is absorbed.

headline: GOLD STOCKS MOST OVERSOLD SINCE 2023 — Autumn Rally Imminent; Hamilton Sees 20-30% GDX Surge on Any Gold Recovery
snippet: Adam Hamilton's latest GoldSeek analysis argues that gold stocks have been pounded to their most oversold technical extreme since October 2023 — the cyclical low that launched GDX's subsequent 347% surge — creating a textbook setup for the sector's strongest seasonal period. Hamilton identifies the historical average autumn gold rally at 10.1%, notes that GDX typically amplifies gold's move by 2x–3x, and calculates that a conservative 10% precious metals rebound from current oversold conditions could translate into 20–30% gains for major gold miners by late September. The analysis cites bearish sentiment compression, deeply depressed positioning, and the contrast between record producer earnings and collapsing valuations as the three conditions historically present at durable gold-stock bottoms.

headline: GOLD MINERS NEAR-RECORD Q2 EARNINGS — Yet GDX Trades at 20x P/E After 21% Q2 Drop; Valuation Disconnect Deepening
snippet: With Q2 2026 reporting season opening, gold miners are on track to post their second-best quarterly earnings on record — implied unit profits expected to soar approximately 50% year-over-year, following 12 consecutive quarters of compounding growth — yet the GDX top 25 are trading at average P/E ratios of just 20.2x, roughly 6/10ths below where they stood before Q1's blowout results. GDX dropped 21% in the second quarter of 2026 despite sector AISC guidance averaging $1,703 per ounce against gold prices that averaged more than $4,700 during Q2; the ETF remains up approximately 50% on a trailing-year basis. The structural mismatch between record cash generation and sector-wide valuation compression is the central puzzle in gold equities heading into the back half of the year.
